metadata.title: Plug Power's stock rises ahead of earnings and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
21 hours ago
Plug Power's stock rises ahead of earnings and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Monday's premarket action:
Shares of Plug Power rose 5.5% ahead of the clean energy company's second-quarter results, due after the closing bell.
Super Micro Computer's stock climbed more than 3% ahead of the server producer's earnings due after the close on Tuesday. Chip stocks, including Marvell Technology and Intel, also saw gains.
Apple fell 1.2% after analysts at Jefferies cut shares to underperform and lowered the stock's price target after its supply-chain checks showed plans for an all-glass iPhone were cancelled due to low yield. The analysts called that a "major setback to efforts to bring in higher-priced iPhones amid soaring memory costs."
